title: PN: Prime number theorems formalized in Lean (Sylvester–Schur)
description: Formal, machine-checked proofs in Lean 4 / Mathlib of classical prime-number theorems: Sylvester–Schur (the product of k consecutive integers each greater than k has a prime factor > k), unboundedness of prime gaps, and exact values of the Jacobsthal function (j(2310) = 14). Complete Sylvester–Schur proof: 0 'sorry', 0 errors.
